visual_name: Day in the life, part forty: end of week (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js clock-tower room (cut away at the front: brick walls, beams, the giant clock face seen from behind with mirrored numerals and turning hands, wall gears, a big floor gear, a swinging pendulum, a bench and a crate), box-built creator with curly black hair, round glasses, a moustache, a green cardigan and mustard trousers, phone sheets for the brand's chat (end of week, When exactly?, ASAP!!, no rush :), EOD, scrolling) / Posted it! Fri 9:00 AM and 'oh we meant Tuesday' / the YourBrand campaign page (Tock Watches, Fall drop, Active, Nov 24 to Nov 28, 4 days left, Days left 4, Delivered 0 / 3) / the brand today, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.8 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: in a clock tower, the brand said the deadline was end of week. Whose week? Which end? Then ASAP, then no rush, then EOD. He lives in a clock tower and still did not know: posted Friday, they meant Tuesday, and he goes limp on the turning floor gear. Then YourBrand: the campaign page has the dates, Days left 4, Delivered 0 / 3, a number that counts down. He posted Monday, early, for the first time ever. The brand still says end of week; he just checks the number.
